title: The first clubs and the daylight system! - ProEvoClubs
author: ChrisLamaq
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/7cmbawdpa54i1.png

https://i.redd.it/7e5mkywpa54i1.png

Hey everyone!, just wanted to drop a quick pics of what im working on in my game 🙂 

  
**First clubs!:** I already a dozen of different clubs design (different building, format, and architectural choices) each of them with their own official and practice fields and a lot of features in it! (wont spoil much today), but you can already see the video of the simple walkthrough at night in the club Casona Norte (clubs are a shared online space for all members, with proximity chat and different activities).

**Daylight system:** 4 (for now) different daylight ambients, which is the base test for a more complex system to come, showing a couple of pictures of each, also recorded in Casona Norte!.

**Sound system:** More details also to come, but the basics of how the game will sound its mostly done, with different trigering surfaces and connected to the daylight system.

Id love to know your feedback!

https://reddit.com/link/1y6s6qf/video/jrsgu9x6g54i1/player
